notes.title: Summary of August updates for 'Strange Dreams' Demo
notes.content:
[p]1. Added a heavyweight Steam online connection function, which allows you to switch roles and play small games, take a walk, and enjoy the scenery together! Support 2-8 people to open rooms online (there may be some undiscovered bugs)
2. Further enriched the maps of alleys, pool cores, amusement parks, back rooms, schools, etc., added more weather, and added more items to the Wanxiang Editor
2. Optimized the image quality, added flood, color, and dispersion effects, added blues filters, optimized some performance, and higher frame rates. Later, some small tools will be launched to help everyone improve frame rates! The goal is to enable smooth gameplay on graphics cards around RTX1060!
3. Late night liver explosion fixes countless bugs, UP really hurts the liver!! QWQ (The pressure is indeed high, stemming from one's perfectionism and a tendency to nitpick details)
4. Beautify the overall UI interface for better UI interaction
5. Enrich the interactive system, add item story introductions, and enhance immersion
6. Absorb countless player feedback and improve details

The most time-consuming part of this month is the online mode (fun is fun, but there are really too many bugs and it's not easy to test, and the liver is bursting). In the future, we will mainly focus on enhancing the sense of dream core and immersion, and continue to develop the scene. We hope everyone stays tuned for the official version on October 29th!

UP junior students who play independent games have average economic conditions and spend a huge amount of time and energy day and night. If they want to support UP, they can love power generation or Bilibili charging sponsorship. Thank you very much \[crying] \[crying].
